results.title: First Look at Everything New in the iOS 27.2 Beta 1 Release
results.description: Apple has officially launched iOS 27.2 Beta 1 for developers, bypassing the anticipated iOS 27.1 release entirely. This update introduces a range of enhancements, including significant updates to the Health app, expanded Siri language support, and improvements across FaceTime, Podcasts, and Apple TV. Additionally, minor design tweaks and performance adjustments are included.
